messages:
Ivy: Quick poll  whos up for a 'mismatched mug & socks' holiday show-and-tell tomorrow at lunch? Bring the weirdest mug you own and wear two different socks. Photo contest, winner gets bragging rights + a tiny tin of spiced tea :tea:
Sam: I'm in. I have a mug with a tiny keyboard glued to it. It haunts me.
Noelle: Count me! Also quick kudos  shoutout to @Sam for the last-minute deploy scripts that saved demo day.
Jasper: Love this. Will bring my novelty rocket mug. Also can we do a quick rule: no brand shaming, keep it fun.
PantryBot: Pantry note: spiced tea tins available at 2pm today. Please label allergy-safe items. :package:
Ivy: Rules: one photo, PG, post in this thread or bring printed. We'll vote by reactions with :snowflake:. Also add a one-line kudos for someone on the team.
Sam: Posting my photo in 5  also kudos to @Noelle for thorough PR reviews this quarter.
Noelle: Uploaded: mug with a tiny rubber duck stuck on the handle. Kudo to @Jasper for clearing the flaky test backlog.
Jasper: Uploaded: my rocket mug mid-launch (it leaks, do not recommend). Kudo to @Ivy for organizing cozy things all season.
Ivy: Voting time  react :snowflake: to pick the winner. Last call for kudos.
Sam: :snowflake: on @Noelle (duck mug is peak)
Noelle: :snowflake: on @Sam (keyboard mug forever)
Jasper: :snowflake: on @Ivy for getting us together and the tea idea
PantryBot: Reactions: :snowflake: x3.
Ivy: Alright winners are decided by consensus (and my terrible tie-breaking coin). I'll bring the spiced tea to the winners and some extra for the office. Happy almost-holidays everyone! :tada:
